status: draft — issue #509, epic #507; read by scripts/contracts/contract.sh and the module's command. Format: docs/records/design-reviews/io-contract-modules.md > 5.
goal: The design implemented within the cycle's scope on the cycle's branch, and every item of the verification design verified as it says — or, where it cannot be, the reason recorded.

base.note: the branch the pull request is to merge into, the baseline of the lint chain's execution trust boundary (docs/submodule-common-rules.md > Verification and Tools); not given, the remote's default branch

previous_report.note: previous_report and findings are given on a re-run.

deferred.note: a JSON array of the recommendations deferred or separated after earlier evaluations, each {subject, finding, disposition}; the build leaves them to their disposition (the form is delivery.json's)

checks.note: the commits the run made on the branch, from its head at check-in; a run that makes none says why in the report's ## No commit section (Q19)

green_blocker.note: Written when the design cannot be built as it stands: the decision that blocks and why. The design module takes it as an input on its re-run.
